title.narrative: Enhanced institutional and national capacities for inclusive, gender-responsive, and sustainable social protection strategies, policies, and legal frameworks, ensuring sound governance and adequate financing

description.narrative: India’s social security system is complex with the combination of central, state and occupational welfare boards’ schemes. Certain autonomy is given to each state and therefore a review of social security system has to be conducted at the state level while the review results of central schemes need to be taken into account. ILO’s technical assistance will be aligned to support the priorities of the constituents. The key focus of the CPO will be: ILO-ESIC project on improving health sector in India, extension of social protection to gig and platform workers; providing technical assistance to the governement for addressing Social protection data deficiency that would reflect improvement in coverage of social protection in India;
